question: Which of the following is NOT an example of application software?
solution:
The correct answer is __Windows Vista**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Windows Vista__ is not considered application software.
 
• It is a system software that serves as an operating system.
 
• System software is designed to operate and manage computer hardware and provide a platform for running application software.
 
• Examples of application software include Google Chrome, Adobe Photoshop, and WhatsApp.
 
• Application software is used by end users to perform specific tasks such as browsing the internet, editing photos, or sending messages.
 
• In contrast, system software like Windows Vista is crucial for the overall operation of the computer system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **System Software:**
 
 
• This type of software includes the operating system and utility programs.
 
• It acts as a bridge between the hardware and application software.
 
 
 
• **Application Software:**
 
 
• Designed to help users perform specific tasks such as creating documents, browsing the web, or graphic designing.
 
• Examples include web browsers, word processors, and media players.
 
 
 
• **Utility Software:**
 
 
• Utility software is a type of system software designed to help analyze, configure, optimize, and maintain the computer.
 
• Examples include antivirus programs, file management tools, and disk cleanup utilities.
